arStrings.szText: {c_important}Sever{/c} sends out {c_number}3{/c} additional specters at its apex that expand out, dealing {c_number}{payload:LOTUS_DAMAGE_OUT}{/c} damage each.
{c_important}Sever{/c} is also a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill that dashes you forward to attack instead.
{c_important}Sever{/c} deals Cold damage, {c_important}{u}Chills{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[{SF_35}|%|]{/c}, and seeks another enemy to attack again.
{c_important}Sever{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_6*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage, and an additional {c_number}[SF_12*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for each {c_important}Minion{/c} you have.
{c_important}Sever{/c} Slows enemies by {c_number}[{SF_33}|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} seconds and forms a Corpse.
{c_important}Sever{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_32*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/c}{/u}.
